Front End Developer Intern — Space Softech, Jaipur
We are looking for a Frontend Developer Intern who is eager to learn and gain hands-on experience in web development. The candidate should have basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with React.js being an added advantage.
Key Responsibilities:
- Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
- Convert designs into functional webpages.
- Integrate REST APIs and work with JSON.
- Debug and resolve frontend issues.
- Collaborate with developers and designers.
- Follow coding and development best practices.
Requirements:
- Fresher or 0–1 year experience.
- Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, and Git/GitHub.
- Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn.
